title: Matched fixed-experimental-volume sensitivity for LLZTO occupancy realization 0
research_question: At 800 K, how does retaining the experimental lattice volume instead of relaxing the cell alter tracer, collective, and correlated lithium transport?
primary_estimands: fixed-experimental versus relaxed-cell tracer diffusivity ratio
fixed-experimental versus relaxed-cell collective diffusivity ratio
fixed-experimental versus relaxed-cell collective-to-tracer ratio contrast
stopping_rule: The sensitivity is interpretable only when both matched 800 K arms independently pass the corresponding estimator's convergence rules; no unresolved estimator is dropped.

gates.criterion: Run only after the full universal-potential domain gate passes.
Use the same occupancy, velocity seed, 20 ps equilibration, 500 ps production, thermostat, timestep, and estimator settings as the relaxed-cell 800 K reference; only cell relaxation is disabled.

runs.purpose: Matched fixed-experimental-volume control for formal-occ00-vel1701 at 800 K.
